annotations.title: Track a licence or service renewal

description: Adds a software licence, plugin, theme, SaaS subscription or other service renewal to the signed-in user's TLDix list. Alerts go out 30, 7 and 1 days before the date.

category.description: Category such as plugin, theme, saas, email (optional).

client.description: Client or reference this item belongs to (optional).

renewal_date.description: Renewal or expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: add_license_renewal
